orthography: Swiss Standard German: ss instead of ß (Massnahme, ausserhalb, gross); Swiss workplace words where they differ (Sitzung, Znüni)

method.topics: Claude Opus 5.5 drafted units from Yoko's profile in the PO brief (powder-mix methodology in Winterthur; goals: work vocabulary, correct Standard German, Swiss German listening). The 5 units required by the brief (A–E) came first; F (pressing/sintering) and G (everyday work) were added because her error discussions cross into those steps and the specialist units need everyday language around them. Ranking: B and C first (named goals, used weekly; C is reusable in every meeting), then A, D, E, F, G. No external sources or company documents used. Not yet reviewed by Yoko.
open: Yoko to confirm or reorder the candidate units.
Exam benchmark (e.g. Goethe B1) not chosen yet; exam task types will be a separate item set, work topics stay practice content.

units.title_ja: 混合プロセスを説明する
units.situation: Yoko explains to a new colleague, an operator or an auditor how a powder mix is made: which powders, which lubricant, how long it is mixed, what is checked on each batch.
units.why: This is her core responsibility; she has to explain the method and process in German every week.

units.title_ja: 生産上の問題を報告する
units.situation: Something is wrong in production (density out of tolerance, cracks after sintering, more scrap); Yoko reports it to the shift leader or in the morning meeting and asks to look into it.
units.why: Discussing the causes of production errors is one of her named goals; a clear report in German decides how fast a problem is fixed.

units.title_de: In der Sitzung die Meinung sagen
units.title_en: Giving your opinion in a meeting
units.situation: In a meeting Yoko gives her opinion, agrees, disagrees politely, raises concerns and asks a colleague for theirs.
units.why: She has to give her opinion and defend her methodology; polite but clear disagreement is hard in a second language.

units.title_ja: 品質保証の改善を提案する
units.situation: Yoko proposes a change to the quality process: more samples per batch, a new test in the inspection plan, a corrective action after a deviation.
units.why: Improving the QA process is part of her job; proposals need the right nouns and the polite conditional (wir könnten, es wäre sinnvoll).

units.title_ja: 職場のスイスドイツ語を聞き取る
units.situation: Colleagues speak dialect at the coffee break, on the shop floor and in short phone calls; Yoko recognises the frequent words and answers in Standard German.
units.why: Listening is her third goal and Winterthur colleagues speak Züritüütsch; she does not need to speak it, only to understand it.
units.needs: audio from Swiss sources (see materials list); items will be listening items

units.title_ja: プレスと焼結を説明する
units.situation: Yoko talks with the press and furnace teams about what happens to her mix after mixing: compaction, green part, sintering atmosphere, shrinkage.
units.why: Many production errors she must discuss start or show up in pressing and sintering, so she needs the words of the next process steps.

units.title_ja: 日常業務：引き継ぎ・予定・短いメール
units.title_en: Everyday work: handover, appointments, short e-mails
units.situation: Shift handover, moving an appointment, a short e-mail to the lab or the supplier, asking for a test result.
units.why: Everyday work German she uses daily; it makes the specialist units usable in real conversations.
